On the training data the hinge is closed for 644 customers (churn rate 24.7%, against 12.1% for the 3356 with it open).
Of the 318 customers with four or more calls (churn rate 50.0%), 285 have it closed.

The voice-mail plan acts through the chain's first unit (node 5116): for the typical customer at a daytime charge of 45 US dollars the predicted risk is 40.1% without a voice-mail plan and 2.1% with one, while at 30 US dollars it makes little difference (1.4% with the plan, 1.4% without).

The model is nearly flat in daytime charge up to a point and then rises steeply, much less so with a voice-mail plan (40.1% without and 2.1% with a plan at 45 US dollars).
